low_improvement_value: There is a building here but the county only values it at a sum
stale_assessment: The county's record for this parcel was last updated in an old year
vacant_land: County record shows no improvement value
trust_owner: Owner of record is a trust
government_owner: Owner of record looks like a government body
entity_owner: Owner of record is a company, not a person
building_worth_less_than_dirt: The building is valued at well under the land it sits on
cleanup_lien: The City holds a cleanup / demolition lien of a sum
estate_owner: Owner of record looks like an estate or heirs
institutional_owner: Owner of record looks like a bank or lender
record_says_building_map_says_none: The tax roll says this parcel is improved, but no building shows in the mapped footprints
absentee_owner: Absentee owner - owner gets the tax bill at a PO box
septic_likely: No City sewer main nearby - septic likely
possible_no_access: No road shows next to this parcel on the map
flood_zone: FEMA maps this as flood zone AE
no_address: No situs address on the tax roll
owner_occupied: Tax bill goes to the property - probably owner-occupied
city_water: City water meter at the address
vacant_per_lien_record: Marked vacant on the City's lien record
map_says_building_record_says_vacant: A building footprint shows on this parcel but the tax roll calls it vacant
tax_delinquent: Certified to the State for unpaid taxes - a sum.94 owed
unknown_owner: No owner name in the record
